wu: Warm-up: 'Problem-Solution Chain'. Teacher writes a problem (e.g., 'plastic waste') on the board. Students take turns adding a solution (e.g., 'recycle it') and a new problem (e.g., 'not enough bins') using 'because of' and 'so that'.
wuAlt: Alternative 1: 'Environmental Pictionary' – students draw environmental problems and guess using 'because of'
Alternative 2: 'Quick Poll' – teacher asks 'What's the biggest environmental problem in Oujda?' and students respond with 'I think... because of...'
pres: Presentation: Show flashcards of environmental problems (pollution, deforestation) and solutions (recycling, planting trees). Model sentences: 'There's a lot of plastic pollution because of too much packaging.' 'We recycle plastic so that we don't waste resources.' Check understanding by asking 'Why?' and 'What can we do?'
presAlt: Alternative 1: 'Problem-Solution Matching' – match problems to solutions on the board with target language
Alternative 2: 'Realia Show' – bring a plastic bottle and a reusable one to demonstrate 'because of' and 'so that'
prac: Guided practice: 'Sentence Scramble'. Students work in pairs to unscramble cause/effect sentences (e.g., 'waste / because of / too much / there is / plastic'). Teacher monitors and corrects pronunciation of 'because of' and 'so that'.
pracAlt: Alternative 1: 'Fill-in-the-Blanks' – worksheet with 'because of' and 'so that' gaps about local issues
Alternative 2: 'Chain Drill' – students take turns completing sentences: 'There's litter because of...' 'We clean up so that...'
ls: Listening slot: Play a short audio (1 min) about a Moroccan beach cleanup. Students listen and fill in a table: 'Problem', 'Cause', 'Solution'. Check answers as a class.
re: Reactivation game: 'Environmental Charades'. After break, students act out environmental problems or solutions (e.g., 'planting trees', 'throwing trash') while others guess using 'Is it... because of...?'
prod: Production task: 'Solutions Poster'. Teams create a poster for a Moroccan environmental issue (e.g., water waste in Oujda). They must write 3 problem-solution sentences using 'because of' and 'so that'. Present posters to the class.
rw: Reading and writing slot: Read a short text (80 words) about solar energy in Morocco. Students underline all 'because of' and 'so that' phrases. Then write 3 sentences about their own energy use using the target language.
st: Story / song + goodbye: Play 'Reduce, Reuse, Recycle' song (lyrics on board). Close with: 'Today we discussed environmental problems and solutions using because of/so that. Thank you for your hard work.'
g: Students take turns adding problems and solutions using target language
Students draw problems and guess with 'because of'
Act out problems/solutions while others guess
Teams create and present a poster for a local issue
diff: Fast finishers: Add a 'future solution' sentence using 'will' to their poster
Support: Provide sentence starters like 'There is... because of...' and 'We can... so that...'
hw: Homework 1: Write 5 sentences about your family's habits using 'because of' and 'so that'
Homework 2: Research one environmental solution in Morocco and write a paragraph
Homework 3: Record a 1-minute video explaining a problem and solution using the target language
tip: Use local examples (e.g., plastic waste in Oujda, solar energy projects) to make the lesson relevant and boost engagement.
